references.text: God gives the same command to Joshua to be strong and courageous, and promises that he will lead the children of Israel into the promised land.
Repetition of the command to be strong and courageous, with the promise that the Lord will be with Joshua.
Moses gives similar encouragement to all Israel to be strong and courageous, with the promise of God's presence.
Moses commands Joshua to be strong and courageous, and assures him that the Lord will go before him.
Joshua is appointed as Moses' successor and given authority to lead the children of Israel.
God's promise to be with Moses, now repeated to Joshua.
God's promise to be with Joshua just as He was with Moses.
Reference to God's promise never to leave or forsake His people, reflecting the promise given to Joshua.
